0022600104.text: Charlotte, 1-0 on the road and currently 3rd in the Southeast and 6th in the East, hosts the 0-1 Miami Heat, who are 5th in the Southeast, 1 games back, and 15th in the East. The Hornets will be without Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee, surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Hornets lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, though Charlotte won the most recent meeting 136-106 in Charlotte on March 17, 2026.
